data.name: TwinLibrary_FavouritesNote
data.value: Your favourite snapshots. A click on a filled ♥ takes one off.

data.name: TwinLibrary_NoFavourites
data.value: No favourites yet: click the ♥ beside a snapshot to keep it here.

data.name: TwinLibrary_CompareTip
data.value: Tick two to five snapshots, then compare them side by side.

data.name: TwinLibrary_PickTip
data.value: Tick to compare (two to five) or to delete together

data.name: TwinCompare_RelativeTip
data.value: Shows how much more (+, green) or less (-, red) each snapshot has than the reference; a stat it doesn't list counts as 0. Hover a value for the number itself and the change in percent.

data.name: TwinCompare_SortTip
data.value: Puts the stats where the others differ most from the reference first in each section. A stat's difference is the change in percent, averaged over the others (+20%, +40% and -20% give +13.3%); a big drop counts as much as a big gain. Equal ones keep their order.

data.name: Twin_SpecializationsNote
data.value: Read from the skill ids of this player's own hits. A stigma's number shows how far its specializations are unlocked, and the ones below count too (still to be confirmed). Effects as the game words them, in English.

data.name: Settings_FightGraphs_SmoothTip
data.value: The curves follow an average of the seconds around each (about ±5 s), so single big hits don't make them spiky; peaks stay where they were. Hovering still lists each second's own values.

data.name: FightGraphs_BestTip
data.value: Your best complete kill of this boss by {0}: {1}, {2} long. Click to hide or show it.

data.name: FightGraphs_FirstBest
data.value: ★ First complete kill of {0}: kept as your best pull.

data.name: FightGraphs_CompareTip
data.value: Tick two to five stored runs, then compare their graphs one below the other.

data.name: FightGraphs_EqualTimeTip
data.value: On: a second is as wide in every graph, so the longest run fills the width and shorter ones end early; how long a spike lasts, or the gap between damage taken and healing, compares directly. Off: each run fills the width.

data.name: FightGraphs_StoreTip
data.value: Keeps the pull shown, with its history entry, in the Stored runs tab.

data.name: FightGraphs_StoreFailed
data.value: This pull can't be stored: you aren't in it, or the boss or your character isn't known yet.

data.name: FightGraphs_SortTip
data.value: Click to sort by it, the best first; again to reverse.

data.name: FightGraphs_NoBestRuns
data.value: No best runs here yet. Each complete kill is compared with your bests and kept when it beats one.

data.name: FightGraphs_NoStoredRuns
data.value: Nothing stored here yet. "Store run" on the Fight graphs tab keeps the pull it shows.

data.name: FightGraphs_OpenTip

data.name: FightGraphs_OpenFailed

data.name: FightGraphs_DeleteTip

data.name: FightGraphs_RunValuesNote
